description: DELEGATED INFERENCE: Offload a completion to a model you choose for cost savings and privacy. Without provider, runs on the live LOCAL provider that has the model (never a hosted API unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set); the result's 'provider', 'host' and 'local' fields say where it ran. Supports system prompts, JSON / JSON-Schema output (validated 'parsed' field), seed/topP/topK, image inputs for vision models, and contextLength for long inputs. Streams tokens via MCP progress notifications when the client sends a progressToken.

contextLength.description: Context window to run with (Ollama num_ctx). Raise it for long inputs to avoid truncation.

messages.description: Chat messages; content may be a string or text/image parts (vision models)

model.description: Model id/name to run the completion on

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

schema.description: JSON Schema the output must satisfy

responseFormat.description: Constrain output to JSON (json_object) or a JSON Schema (json_schema); the result includes a validated 'parsed' value

stream.description: Stream tokens (default true). Progress notifications are sent when the client provides a progressToken.

name: complete
title: Delegated completion
